payload.claim: The binary contains a dedicated validation function called checkSerial that is separate from main. The validation logic is in checkSerial, not in the main function.

derivation.consensus: 7/7 writeups identify checkSerial as the key validation function

payload.claim: The binary checks the length of the input before doing any other validation. Understanding the required length is the first step to understanding the validation algorithm.

derivation.consensus: 7/7 writeups identify a strlen-based length check as the first validation step

payload.claim: The validation loop processes the input in pairs of adjacent characters and checks an arithmetic relationship between each pair. The validation depends on the relationship between character pairs, not on individual character values.

derivation.consensus: 7/7 writeups identify the pairwise character comparison with arithmetic constraint
